title: Borsuk-Ulam type theorem for Stiefel manifolds and orthogonal mass partitions
summary: We prove a Borsuk--Ulam-type zero theorem for the Stiefel manifold $V_{n,k}$ with the free action of the hyperoctahedral group $B_k=(\mathbb{Z}/2)^k\rtimes S_k$. The theorem gives a nonvanishing criterion for explicit polynomials in ${R}_{n,k}=\mathbb{F}_2[a_1,\ldots,a_k]/(a_1^n,a_2^{n-1},\ldots,a_k^{n-k+1})$. We apply this criterion to equipartitions by mutually orthogonal hyperplanes.
